_doc: Meeting script templates for crewmates. Keys are situations detected by the engine. Placeholders: {P} target player, {R} room, {T} time (m:ss), {W} witness, {V} victim, {TASK} task name, {N} number. Each entry: question templates (ask), statement templates (say), what to watch for. Lines are plain chat language (<= 70 chars, no commas chains) because they get copied into the game chat as is.
principles: Give your own location + companion FIRST. It pre-empts accusations and models the behaviour you want.
Lead with hard clears. A confirmed-crew list is the most valuable thing you can say.
Ask questions whose answers can be checked against what someone else saw.
Make people commit to a story early; contradictions only exist once stories are on record.
Vote skip when nobody has evidence. A wrong eject is worth more than a kill to the impostors.
Watch who agrees without adding info. Bandwagons hide impostors.
Count. Alive crew vs impostors decides whether a skip is safe.

say: I was in {R} with {W} all round.
{P} is clear, I saw them do {TASK} in {R}.
ask: Where was everyone when the body was found?
watch: Anyone who answers with a question instead of a location.

ask: {P} why were you in {R} and who did you see on the way?
{P} what task do you have in {R}?
say: {P} reported alone in {R}. Nobody saw them go in.
watch: If {P} names a task that isn't in {R} on this map.
If {P} names a companion who then denies it.

ask: {R} is a dead end. Who went in or out? I saw {P} leave around {T}.
say: Body in {R}, one way in. Last one through that door explains.
watch: Vent networks touching {R}: anyone who 'appeared' nearby without passing the door.

ask: {P} you were with {V} in {R} around {T}. Where did you split?
say: Last one I saw with {V} was {P} in {R} around {T}.
watch: Whether {P} offers the split location unprompted or deflects.

ask: {P} you said {TASK} in {R}. Everyone has that task. Who else did it?
say: I dont have {TASK}. Common tasks are the same for everyone.
watch: Anyone who suddenly 'also has it' with no location.
This is near-proof if the lobby's common tasks are known.

say: {TASK} is not in {R}. {P} which panel did you use?
ask: {P} where exactly in {R} is {TASK}?
watch: Specificity. Crew can name the panel; impostors go vague.

ask: {P} {TASK} is visual. Who saw it?
say: Visuals are on. Nobody saw {P} do {TASK}.
watch: If {P} downgrades to a non-visual task after being asked.

ask: When lights went off who went to fix them? {P} came late from {R}.
say: Kill was during lights. Whoever was lost in the dark is the question.
watch: Anyone who claims they were 'on the way' but arrived from the wrong direction.

ask: {P} reactor was called and you were at neither panel. Where were you?
say: {W} and I fixed {TASK} together so {W} is clear.
watch: Who benefits from a split: the impostor usually ends up on the smaller side.

say: {P} said {R} at {T} but {W} saw {P} in {R2}. One of those is wrong.
That is not what {P} said last meeting.
ask: {P} {W} says you were in {R2} not {R}. Which is it?
watch: Whether {P} attacks {W}'s credibility instead of answering.

ask: {P} what did you actually see? Sus is not a location.
say: {P} is pushing {P2} with no sighting. Where were you {P}?
watch: Impostors often accuse first to look proactive.

say: Only hard clears count now. {W} is confirmed crew.
{N} impostors left. We cannot skip.
ask: {P} and {P2} where were you for the last kill? Room and time.
watch: The impostor will try to make it a vibe vote. Keep it to kill windows.

say: Nobody has anything. Skip and move in pairs.
ask: Everyone say your room and who you were with.
watch: Who resists committing to a location.

say: {P} hard defended {P2} who was impostor. Pair tell.
ask: {P} why were you so sure {P2} was clear?
watch: Any two players who never vote each other across meetings.

say: Stack kill. {P} {P2} {P3} were all there. Who was closest to {V}?
ask: {P} {P2} {P3} who was next to the body before the report?
watch: The one who claims they 'didn't notice' the kill.

say: Kill cooldown is {N}s after a meeting. No kill before that.
ask: Where was everyone after the first {N} seconds?
watch: Alibis that only cover the first seconds of the round prove nothing.

say: Two kills {N}s apart. That is two impostors, not one.
ask: Who was near {R} and who was near {R2} at {T}?
watch: A player cleared for one kill is still open for the other.

say: Comms were down then. Admin and cams were off.
ask: {P} when exactly did you check it? Comms was sabotaged.
watch: Readings claimed inside a comms window are made up.

say: {TASK} is not fixed in {R} on this map.
ask: {P} where exactly did you fix {TASK}?
watch: Wrong fix spots mean the player was not at the sabotage.

say: Impostors can fix sabotage too. Fixing is not a clear.
ask: {P} who was at the fix with you?
watch: Only a two-person fix with a cleared partner is an alibi.

say: {P} was at the fake panel in {R}. Nobody can do that task.
ask: {P} what task were you doing in {R}?
watch: Skeld reactor divert, Polus office divert, Airship armory/comms/vault wires.

say: {TASK} goes in a fixed order. {R} cant be first.
ask: {P} where did you do the first part of {TASK}?
watch: Upload is always admin on Skeld and comms on Polus.

say: {TASK} is not visual on this map. That clears nobody.
ask: Did anyone see a real visual? Scan counts.
watch: The clearer is usually just wrong, not an impostor.

say: Visuals are off. Only scan waiting proves anything.
ask: {P} did the scan say waiting for {P2}?
watch: Clears based on animations mean nothing with visuals off.

say: You cant spawn in {R} on Airship.
ask: {P} which spawn did you pick, and then where?
watch: Spawns are brig, cargo, engine, kitchen, main hall, records.

say: That was during mixup. Colours were random then.
ask: {P} was that before or after the mixup?
watch: Drop colour sightings from the mixup window.

say: {V} was alive on vitals at {T}.
ask: Who checked vitals and when did {V} go DED?
watch: Claims of finding {V} before that time are false.

say: Doorlog shows {P} at the {R} sensor at {T}.
ask: Who checked doorlog? Who crossed the hallway?
watch: Crossing one sensor then appearing on the far side means vents.

say: I was on cams. {P} never walked past {R}.
ask: Who was on cams and which feed were you on?
watch: Polus and Airship show one feed at a time.

say: Admin had {N} in {R} at {T}.
ask: Who else was in {R} around {T}?
watch: Admin does not show hallways or Polus outside.

say: {P} went into {R} and was gone. There is a vent.
ask: {P} how did you get out of {R}?
watch: Phantom vanish if Phantom is on; Engineers can vent too.

say: {P} crossed gap room without the platform.
ask: {P} platform or the long way round?
watch: Gap room left and right vents connect.

say: I left {P} alone with {V} in {R}. Then {V} died.
ask: {P} where did you split from {V}?
watch: A shapeshifter could have worn {P}.

say: {P} came out of {R} right before the report.
ask: {P} you were in {R}. Didnt you see {V}?
watch: Whether {P} admits being in {R} at all.

say: {V} died seconds before {P} reported.
ask: {P} who did you see on the way to {R}?
watch: Real witnesses name the killer; self reporters name nobody.

say: {P} knew the body was in {R} before anyone said.
ask: {P} how did you know it was in {R}?
watch: Details only the killer or a witness could know.

say: I saw {P} vent in {R}.
ask: {P} where were you right before the meeting?
watch: Engineers on? Then ask if {P} went in and out fast.

say: I saw {P} kill {V} in {R}.
ask: Anyone else see {P} near {R}?
watch: Shapeshifter on? Then the killer may only look like {P}.

say: There were two {P}s at once. One is a shapeshifter.
ask: Who saw {P} at {T} and where?
watch: The copy that changes back is the impostor.

say: {P} says they were with {W}. {W} says no.
ask: {W} were you with {P}? Yes or no.
watch: The one with other holes in their story is lying.

say: From {R2} {P} would have passed me. They didnt.
ask: {P} which way did you walk to {R}?
watch: Routes that skip a watched hallway.

say: {P} did {TASK} in a few seconds. It takes longer.
ask: {P} did you finish {TASK} or close it?
watch: Download/upload ~9 s, scan ~10 s, sample needs a 60 s wait.

say: {P} finished {TASK} and the bar did not move.
ask: {P} was that the last part of {TASK}?
watch: Multi-stage tasks only move the bar at the end.

say: {P} dropped {P2} the moment {P2} answered.
ask: {P} why were you sure about {P2} before?
watch: Accusers who never give their own location.

say: Plus ones are not evidence. What did you see?
ask: {P} what did you see yourself?
watch: Late agreers with no location of their own.

say: {N} alive and {N2} impostors left. Count before you skip.
ask: Everyone vote or skip on purpose. No random votes.
watch: With 2 impostors at 7 alive a wrong eject can lose it.

say: Nobody has a sighting. Skip and stay in pairs.
ask: Everyone say room and who you were with.
watch: Who pushes hard for a vote with nothing behind it.
